verdict.rationale: Decagon documents a full QA loop: Watchtower flags failures via natural-language criteria across every interaction, Simulations/Duet auto-generate diverse test cases to validate agent behavior pre- and post-deployment, and Duet automatically iterates on the agent based on conversation gaps, closing the loop back into agent logic; Experiments adds A/B validation of changes. Missing for 10: explicit 'scored sample' rubric/scoring mechanics and independent/hands-on evidence corroborating the review-loop efficacy.
